objective: Receipts are Ed25519-signed with the private key outside the repo and the public key committed; the CLI rejects bad ids and bad FTS queries with documented exit codes
success_conditions: Tampered or wrong-key receipts fail verification
A fresh clone verifies with only the committed public key
Invalid ids and FTS queries print a clean error and a documented exit code

tasks.description: Switch receipts to Ed25519 with public keys in the repo
Validate ids, contain paths, and quote FTS queries
Split the CLI and map domain errors to exit codes
Document the threat model and CI signing pattern
